FFmpeg WebAssembly core

ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm were copied unchanged from the operator-supplied
2.9.2_0/ffmpeg directory. No donor extension application bundle is included.

Running this exact core with -L reports FFmpeg 5.1.4, Copyright (c) 2000-2023
the FFmpeg developers, and GNU LGPL version 2.1 or later. The complete LGPL 2.1
license is included in COPYING.LGPLv2.1.txt.

Upstream FFmpeg release source:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-5.1.4.tar.xz

The supplied artifact did not include source for its Emscripten wrapper or build
scripts. The exact custom wrapper's source provenance remains unknown. These
files are preserved as supplied, with identities recorded below. The build has
no GPL enable flag and performs stream copying without transcoding.

SHA-256:
ffmpeg-core.js   e952162154d821dc90e5e1af4e5391c4490e602fe8e4a192495f80e89a8cc803
ffmpeg-core.wasm 5ed8fbbd7be5a819821ccc2f3bf33f825d2856185b50ea8d675f39f1a110e18f

Observed build configuration:
--target-os=none --arch=x86_32 --enable-cross-compile --disable-asm
--disable-stripping --disable-programs --disable-doc --disable-debug
--disable-runtime-cpudetect --disable-autodetect --nm=emnm --ar=emar
--ranlib=emranlib --cc=emcc --cxx=em++ --objcc=emcc --dep-cc=emcc
--extra-cflags='-O3 -msimd128 -I/opt/include'
--extra-cxxflags='-O3 -msimd128 -I/opt/include'
--disable-pthreads --disable-w32threads --disable-os2threads --disable-everything
--enable-demuxer=mov --enable-muxer=mp4 --enable-decoder=vp9 --enable-decoder=vp8
--enable-parser=h264 --enable-parser=hevc --enable-parser=av1 --enable-parser=vp9
--enable-parser=vp8 --enable-parser=aac --enable-parser=opus --enable-parser=vorbis
--enable-bsf=aac_adtstoasc --enable-bsf=vp9_superframe --enable-bsf=vp9_raw_reorder
--enable-bsf=null --enable-protocol=file --enable-filter=null --enable-filter=anull
